tenderSchedule.title: Purchase of DRY FODDER to supply to the Government Goshala cattle camps, fodder Banks, in Dharwad district
tenderSchedule.description: Purchase of DRY FODDER to supply to the Government Goshala cattle camps fodder Banks in Dharwad district

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: All terms and conditions are as per tender documnet.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer should have supplied a minimum quantity of 200 tons of dry fodder to the Semi Government/Govt. Departments in any of the immediate past 3 years and the Tax invoices/purchase orders should be uploaded. The satisfactory certificate issued by the Government/Govt. Departments has to be uploaded.
If the tenderer is a Firm Registered Proprietor Partnership Public Sector or Private limited Company should upload registration documents issued by the Competent Authority

The tenderer should have a minimum of 400 Metric Tons of dry fodder in stock with him while applying for tender and a self declaration as per Annexure-II to that effect containing the quantity, place of stock and age of the dry fodder should be uploaded.
The tenderer should furnish the details of address of Dry Fodder stores to enable the tender inviting authority for physical verification where ever necessary.
The tenderer Firm or Company should not have been black listed in any of the Government tenders it participated and a self declaration duly Notarized to that effect should be uploaded.
Clearance certificate of Sale Tax (Latest GST returns) is to be uploaded.
PAN & GST registration details to be uploaded
Annual Turnover Certificates issued by Chartered Accountant for the Previous two years are to be uploaded. The annual turnover shall be Rs. 50 Lakh in any of the immediate previous two years

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover
